mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.10%) compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate applied to equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 0.10%.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 8.0%, it indicates a deteriorating labor market that triggers risk-off sentiment, resulting in negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances when UNRATE > 8.0.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent decline in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) signals a contraction in economic activity, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances when HOUST and INDPRO are both below 3-month trailing averages.

mechanism_narrative: A high inflation environment (CPIAUCSL > 225) combined with elevated policy rates (FEDFUNDS > 0.05) signals an active monetary tightening cycle, reducing equity valuations through higher discount rates and leading to negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 225 and FEDFUNDS > 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Strong real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) reflect robust consumer demand, supporting corporate earnings and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS is above its 1-year moving average.

mechanism_narrative: A negative payroll employment growth rate indicates slowing labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances when PAYEMS growth rate < 0.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent decline in GDP growth (GDPC1 growth rate < 0) and industrial production (INDPRO below 3-month average) signals a contraction in economic output, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances when GDPC1 growth rate < 0 and INDPRO < 3-month average.

mechanism_narrative: A weak housing market (HOUST < 660) combined with subdued consumer spending (RSAFS < 400000) indicates a lack of economic momentum, leading to negative S&P 500 60-day forward returns.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances when HOUST < 660 and RSAFS < 400000.
